rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Disability Insurance Fraud — Fabricated Medical Documentation")`
`comment("Detects providers with identical diagnoses across multiple claimants or geographic anomalies")`
index=flame_insurance sourcetype=flame:claims_management
  (claim_type="short_term_disability" OR claim_type="long_term_disability")
  (claim_status="open" OR claim_status="approved" OR claim_status="in_payment")
| eval policy_to_claim_days = round((strptime(claim_filing_date, "%Y-%m-%d") - strptime(policy_effective_date, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400)
| stats dc(claimant_id) AS unique_claimants
    values(claimant_id) AS claimants
    values(claim_amount) AS claim_amounts
    avg(provider_claimant_distance_miles) AS avg_distance
    BY provider_id, icd10_primary_diagnosis
| where unique_claimants >= 3 OR avg_distance >= 150
| eval risk_score = case(
    unique_claimants >= 5 AND avg_distance >= 150, "critical",
    unique_claimants >= 5, "high",
    avg_distance >= 300, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| table provider_id, icd10_primary_diagnosis, unique_claimants,
        claimants, claim_amounts, avg_distance, risk_score
| sort - unique_claimants
rules.title: DL-0163: Disability Insurance Fraud — Fabricated Medical Documentation Provider Anomaly (SPLUNK)
